title: WIRING DIAGRAM-ENGINE COMPARTMENT
summary: Wiring diagram, engine compartment, left-front portion (all models): LH headlamps (upper lamp labelled ...BEAM, lower lamp label illegible), LH headlamp door warning lamp switch, LH park & directional signal lamp, LH side marker lamp, horn relay & key warning buzzer, brake fluid warning switch, a fusible link and two ground eyelets, with the harness running back to connectors at the dash panel (firewall). Gives wire gauge and color for every lead; wires broken off at the top edge continue on the adjoining sheet. No part numbers on this sheet.
notes_internal: Wire labels are gauge + color code as printed (B black, BRN brown, DBL dark blue, DG dark green, LBL light blue, LG light green, OR orange, P pink, PPL purple, R red, T tan, W white, Y yellow; slashes = tracer colors).
Component label 'HORN RLY & K' WARN BUZZ' is cut off after K (key warning buzzer).
Exact pin-to-pin routing inside the two large dash-panel connectors is not traceable at this resolution; tables list the leads at each component and at the sheet edges only.

Adjoining sheet number key printed lower left: D2 D4 D6 D8 / D1 D3 D5 D7 (D1 highlighted). Wires broken off at the top edge presumably continue on D2 and at the right on D3; the sheet does not say so explicitly.
Fusible link (zig-zag) is drawn on the line labelled 24 BRN/W that runs from the top edge down to the right-hand dash connector.
Title-block sheet id partly smudged; reads D1, matches PREL D1 and the highlighted key box.
